prompts.main: Product photo of a silicone mold for cotton toy doll face. Mold name: {{moldName}}, mold size {{moldSize}} cm, color: {{color}}. White background, studio lighting, sharp focus on the relief texture. Top-down and 3/4 view.
prompts.infographic: Compose a marketplace infographic slide by placing the supplied mold photo(s) onto the provided background template. Do NOT redraw the mold — composite the real photo of the silicone mold «{{moldName}}» ({{color}}, {{topic}} for {{purpose}}) into the central product area of the template, keeping its relief texture intact and well lit. Position the mold photo centered in the upper two-thirds of the slide. Overlay text blocks: the mold name «{{moldName}}» as the heading, the dimensions {{moldLength}}×{{moldWidth}}×{{moldHeight}} cm and the mold size {{moldSize}} cm as a callout in the lower band. Keep the background template's layout, colors and branding; only fill the product slot and text placeholders. Clean, professional, high-contrast.
